integrity: The universal proof is symbolic: for \(p>\alpha n\) and large \(n\), Legendre's formula reduces exactly to \(v_p(n!)=\lfloor n/p\rfloor\); fixed valuation cells are then evaluated by the prime number theorem. The standalone computation checks the exact cell regrouping in 250 finite cases and the predicted parity profile, but the finite replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a fixed-parameter asymptotic on linear prime windows. It gives no uniform error as \(\alpha\downarrow0\), \(h\to\infty\), or \(K\to\infty\) with \(n\), and it does not cover sublinear windows.
title: Linear-window harmonic bias for factorial prime valuations
